name: Montenegro (1860–1905)
description: A red field with a white border, charged at the centre with a white double-headed eagle bearing a red shield with the initials 'Н.І' (Nikola I) and a golden lion at the base.
history: Flag of the Principality of Montenegro (1860–1905) under Prince Nikola I.

features.role: double-headed eagle with the monogram of Nikola I
